title: What If the Loudest Sound in History Happened Today?

finale.sub: Follow for a new What if every day

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: What if the *loudest sound* in history happened today?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Saturday, seven a.m. Every window in town *rattles*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay falls out of *bed*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Outside, the whole street is staring at the *sky*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: No smoke. No fire. Just a *boom*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Fireworks! Who did this? Was it *you*, Jay?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: I was *asleep*!

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: It wasn't fireworks. It was a *volcano*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: We don't *have* a volcano.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: An island. Three thousand miles *away*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The sound took almost four hours to *get here*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Nothing is *that* loud.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: One thing was. *Krakatoa*. Eighteen eighty three.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The loudest sound ever *recorded*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: People heard it three thousand miles away.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: They thought it was a ship firing *cannons*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Sailors forty miles away lost their *eardrums*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Grandpa Ezra steps out, holding a brass *barometer*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: The needle *jumped*. Air doesn't do that.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: That's the air wave. It's going around the *planet*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: And it's coming back. From the *other side*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part two drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part two. A volcanic boom is circling the *Earth*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Coming back? A sound can't come *back*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: This one can. It's a pressure wave. A *ripple*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: In 1883, it circled Earth over *three times*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Barometers caught it seven times. Over *five days*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ezra sets the barometer on his *porch*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Then we *wait*. And we count.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Milo grabs a pencil and makes a *chart*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mayor Doyle calls a press *conference*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: It was a loud noise. It is *over*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nia isn't listening. She's staring at her *phone*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: My mom flies home *tomorrow*. Over that ocean.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit? Is that *safe*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The airlines are watching the ash. For *now*, yes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Midnight. Ezra's needle twitches. *Again*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Lap two! The boom went all the way *around*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The whole street cheers. For a *sound*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: But Bit is watching something *else*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. The harbor gauge just *moved*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: In 1883, the sea felt it. Even in *England*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: A wave is crossing the ocean. Landing at *noon*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part three drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part three. A wave hits the harbor at *noon*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: A *tsunami*? Here?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: A small one. After that far, maybe *one meter*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: One meter. That's my *waist*. That's nothing.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: A meter of moving sea can tip a *truck*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Eight a.m. Jay runs to the *mayor*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Close the fish market? On a *Saturday*?

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: A wave from a volcano we can't even *see*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ezra taps his barometer. *Lap three*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: You couldn't see it either. But you *heard* it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The mayor doesn't *answer*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Eleven a.m. The harbor is *packed*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Fish stalls. Tourists. Boats coming in with the *catch*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And at the very end of the pier, *Milo*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Fishing rod. Headphones. *Very* loud headphones.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Milo! MILO! He can't *hear* me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay starts down the *pier*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Eleven forty. Then the water does something *strange*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: It starts to *leave*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The whole harbor drains. Boats sit on *sand*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And the crowd walks *out* to grab the fish.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part four drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part four. The sea pulled back. People walked *in*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: No! Get out of there! That's the *wave*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit taught him. When the sea leaves, it *returns*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nobody listens. Mayor Doyle holds up a *fish*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Free lunch, everybody!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay sees the old harbor *bell*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: He grabs the rope. And *pulls*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Clang! Clang! *Clang*!

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: That bell means *run*! Up the hill! Now!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The old folks know that bell. They *run*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then everyone runs. Fish and *all*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: But Milo still has his *headphones* on.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay sprints to the end of the *pier*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: On the horizon, a gray line. *Growing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay yanks off the headphones. Milo *yelps*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Don't ask. *Run*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: They hit the hill steps as the water *arrives*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Not a wall. A *fast, rising tide*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: It floods the pier. It flips the fish *stalls*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: From the hill, the whole town *watches*. Safe.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: I'll... buy that bell a new *rope*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. That was the small part. Look *up*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part five drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part five. The town is safe. The sky *isn't*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Seven p.m. The sunset turns *blood red*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Not orange. Not pink. *Red*. Like it's burning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Somebody calls the fire *department*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Three fire trucks race up the hill. Sirens *screaming*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: There's no fire. There's *ash*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Volcanic ash, high in the sky. Bending the *sunlight*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Krakatoa threw ash about fifty miles *up*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Sunsets went red all over the world. For *months*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: New York called out fire engines. *Real* story.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: So the mayor did it *twice*. Once in history.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: I heard that.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Everyone laughs. Except *Nia*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Mom's flight left early. To beat the *ash*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Flight two-twelve. Over the ocean. *Right now*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. Can you see her *plane*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Tracking. Thirty six thousand feet. *Steady*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nia breathes out. Milo falls asleep on her *shoulder*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Eleven p.m. Bit's screen flickers *orange*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The ash cloud moved. It's *in her path*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Flight two-twelve is *descending*. Fast.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part six drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part six. Nia's mom's plane flew into *volcanic ash*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Why is it going *down*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Ash melts inside jet engines. Engines can *stop*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nobody says anything. The room is *silent*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Nia. Listen. This happened *before*. In 1982.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: A jumbo jet flew into volcanic ash at *night*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: All *four* engines stopped.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The captain said: we have a small *problem*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: A *small* problem?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The plane glided. Down, out of the *ash*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: In clean air, the engines started *again*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Everyone on board *lived*. Two hundred sixty three.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nia holds onto that like a *rope*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: So they *glide*. And it works.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Twenty thousand feet. Still *dropping*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ezra comes in with an old radio *scanner*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Air traffic channels. Let's *listen*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Static. Then a calm *voice*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Two-twelve, engines out, *gliding*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nia grabs Jay's hand. He *doesn't* let go.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Fifteen thousand. Then the signal *stops*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part seven drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part seven. The plane is gliding. Signal *gone*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Bit? *Bit*! Where is she?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Low planes drop off my map. That's *normal*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The scanner hisses. Nothing. *Nothing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Milo wakes up. He looks at all their *faces*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Is it Mom? Is Mom *okay*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nia can't answer. So Jay *does*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Her plane is gliding. Planes are *good* at gliding.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: In 1982, a plane did this. Everyone *lived*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Her pilots know about ash. They *train* for it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay is not sure he believes *himself*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Three minutes. Four. *Five*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then the scanner *crackles*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Two-twelve. Engine one *relit*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Engine two *relit*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Three. *Four*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay squeezes Nia's hand. She squeezes *back*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The room *explodes*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Ha! Small problem! *Small problem*!

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Signal back. Twelve thousand feet. *Climbing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ninety minutes later, Nia's phone *rings*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: A crackly line. A *voice*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Mom? Mom, where *are* you?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part eight drops in two days. The final part.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part eight. Engines back. Then Nia's phone *rang*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mom landed at a small airport. Far from *ash*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: She says... *we had a small problem*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nia laughs and cries at the same *time*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Two days later, Mom's home. Milo hugs her *hard*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The boom passes over town one last *time*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Lap seven. Same as 1883! My chart was *right*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mayor Doyle unveils a new rope for the *bell*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: And a *siren*. Just in case.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: For weeks, every sunset stays *red*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Milo paints a face *screaming* at a red sky.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Fun fact. Some think *The Scream* shows that sky.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Munch painted it ten years after *Krakatoa*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Next summer, the north was point four degrees *cooler*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: One volcano. And the whole planet *felt* it.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: One sound. And the whole town *listened*. Eventually.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: That night, they all sit on the hill. *Quiet*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Jay. Thanks for *ringing* the bell.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Thanks for not *letting go*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Can we stop having *small problems* now?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Follow for a new What if every day.
